verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sachaa paatisaahu gurmukh gaaddee raahu chalaiaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru, the real emperor has put the Guru-oriented (gurmukh) on the high road (of liberation).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜਿ ਦੂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਭੂਤ ਵਸਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: pa(n)j dhoot kar bhoot vas dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau miTaiaa|

en.bdb: He restrains the deadly sins, the five evil inclinations and the sense of duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv chalanaa jam jaagaatee neR na aaiaa|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs spend their lives while keeping their heart and mind attuned with the shabad (word) and therefore death, the tax-gatherer does not approach them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੇਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਖੰਡੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bemukh baareh vaaT kar saadhasa(n)gat sach kha(n)dd vasaiaa|

en.bdb: The Guru had dispersed the apostates into the twelve sects (of the yogis), and seated the holy  congregation of the saints in the domain of Truth (the sachkhand).

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਉ ਮੰਤੁ੍ਰ ਦੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhaau bhagat bhau ma(n)tur dhe naam dhaan isanaan dhiraRaiaa|

en.bdb: By the spell of the Naam, the gurmukhs have inculcated love, devotion, fear, charity and ablutions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਮਲ ਹੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jiau jal a(n)dhar kamal hai maiaa vich udhaas rahaiaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs keep themselves unaffected by the evils of the world as the lotus remains dry in water.
Gurmukhs efface their individuality and do not pose to assert themselves.
